defs.def: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders （通常界限不明的）地区，区域，地方

ex.s: Moreover, these data are biased and favor certain regions, time periods, and species.
ex.t: 此外，这些数据存在偏差，偏向某些地区、时段和物种。

ex.s: The garden also contains a winding path that guides visitors through the twelve regions of the Silk Road.
ex.t: 花园还包含一条蜿蜒的小径，引导游客穿越丝绸之路的十二个地区。

ex.s: The result is that many communities, especially in farming regions, see solar farms as destroyers of the soil.
ex.t: 其结果是，许多社区，特别是农业地区的社区，将太阳能农场视为土壤的驱逐舰。

ex.s: Today his hobby has developed into the website postcrossing.com, a social network that has grown to 575,217 registered users in 214 countries and regions since he started it 10 years ago.
ex.t: 如今，他的爱好已发展成一个网站 postcrossing.com——一个社交网络，自他十年前创建以来，已发展到214个国家和地区的575,217名注册用户。

ex.s: “I [had] lost enough sleep over this,” says David Cox, the company's Western region vice president — and that was before the hospital mentioned the tree's distinguished origin.
ex.t: “我为此已经失眠够多了，”该公司西区副总裁David Cox说——而且那还是在医院提到这棵树显赫的来历之前。

ex.s: Chewang Norphel lives in a mountainous region in India, where he is known as the Ice Man.
ex.t: 丘旺·诺普尔生活在印度的一个山区，他在那里被称为"冰人"。

ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.
ex.t: 在西班牙南部，温室（将光线反射回太空）的突然增加已经改变了当地的变暖趋势，实际上使该地区降温了。

ex.s: Firstly, there are few large, flat areas of land in the region.
ex.t: 首先，该地区几乎没有大面积的平坦土地。

ex.s: Secondly, although the region has plenty of rain, the mountains are steep and the soil is shallow.
ex.t: 其次，虽然该地区雨水充足，但山坡陡峭，土壤浅。

ex.s: Though there are many large, flat areas in the region, they built terraces on the mountains to have more areas to grow rice.
ex.t: 虽然该地区有很多大面积平坦的地方，但他们还是在山上修建了梯田，以获得更多的水稻种植面积。

ex.s: Emma ·Around four million people live in the Arctic region, of whom around 170,000 are lnuit.
ex.t: 艾玛：大约有四百万人生活在北极地区，其中约十七万是因纽特人。

ex.s: I have made over 140 work trips, but my best work trip ever was to Broome in the Kimberley region.
ex.t: 我已经出差超过 140 次了，但最棒的一次出差是去金伯利地区的布鲁姆。

ex.s: Now, lots of   7  (country)and regions are taking action to ban the sale of such bags to stop people using them.
ex.t: 现在，许多____7____（country）和地区正采取行动禁止出售此类袋子，以阻止人们使用它们。

ex.s: Declining birth rate is a major problem in many developing regions too, which might cause catastrophic global shortages of work force within a few decades.
ex.t: 出生率下降在许多发展中地区也是一个重大问题，可能在几十年内导致全球劳动力的灾难性短缺。

defs.def: one of the areas that a country is divided into, that has its own customs and/or its own government 行政区
all of a country except the capital city （一国除首都以外的）全部地区，所有区域

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.
ex.t: 此外，约50%的世界人口生活在生育率目前低于替代水平（即每名女性2.1个孩子）的地区，几乎所有发达国家都在经历低于替代水平的生育率。

defs.def: a part of the body, usually one that has a particular character or problem （通常指有某种特性或问题的）身体部位

chunks.en: arctic / cooled / western / farming / certain region
chunks.cn: 北极的地区 / 凉爽的地区 / 西方的地区 / 农场地区 / 确定的地区
